reason: Only entry is JSR sky_col_row (callers sky_col_check in sky_hazel, sky_col_zero in sky_edges); the 'no' label keeps its address (old LDA abs,X+CMP zp+BCC = 7 bytes, new CMP abs,X+BEQ+BCS = 7 bytes; sky_stop is zp &E2). Condition: old goes to no iff ry < stop; new A=stop, CMP sky_ry,X: BEQ continues when equal, BCS no when stop > ry (C=1,Z=0) i.e. ry < stop, otherwise continues - identical. Continue path: next LDA sky_rl,X overwrites A, flags overwritten before read (SEC/CLC set C at exits); sky_stop stored identically. No path: SEC; RTS, both callers then BCS next -> INX/CPX, A and other flags dead. X, Y, stack unchanged. sky_ry=&BCB4, X small, no page cross either way; BEQ offset +2 in &DF2x. No interrupt interaction (zp &E2 and the &BCxx tables are sky-mode scratch, irq1_handler does not read them; the change touches no memory differently). Cycles: continue stop<ry 9->8, stop==ry 9->7, no path 10->9; saves 1-2 per execution.
